name: Phenacaine
summary: Phenacaine, also known as holocaine, is a local anesthetic. It is approved for ophthalmic use.

uses.text: Phenacaine, also known as holocaine, is a local anesthetic. It is approved for ophthalmic use.

pharmacology.en: Like other local anaesthetics it blocks sodium channels in nerve endings, so pain signals cannot be sent.
pharmacology.zh: 與其他局部麻醉劑一樣，它阻斷神經末梢的鈉離子通道，使疼痛訊號無法傳遞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与其他局部麻醉剂一样，它阻断神经末梢的钠离子信道，使疼痛信号无法传递。

sideEffects.en: As eye drops it stings and can irritate or damage the surface of the eye with repeated use. A numbed eye also loses its protective blink reflex.
sideEffects.zh: 作為眼藥水使用時會有刺痛感，反覆使用可能刺激甚至損傷眼表。被麻醉的眼睛也會失去保護性的眨眼反射。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为眼药水使用时会有刺痛感，反复使用可能刺激甚至损伤眼表。被麻醉的眼睛也会失去保护性的眨眼反射。

fact.en: Its old name holocaine dates from the 1890s, when it was one of the first synthetic local anaesthetics for the eye, in the years just after cocaine was found to numb the cornea.
fact.zh: 它的舊名 holocaine 可追溯至 1890 年代，當時它是最早用於眼睛的合成局部麻醉劑之一，就在人們發現古柯鹼能麻醉角膜後不久。
fact.zhHans: 它的旧名 holocaine 可追溯至 1890 年代，当时它是最早用于眼睛的合成局部麻醉剂之一，就在人们发现古柯碱能麻醉角膜后不久。
